profile.name: Karthick Raja G

Passionate about CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and serverless architectures. I use AI-assisted tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude to ship faster and smarter.
I architect scalable solutions on AWS and build full-stack systems, from real-time employee monitoring to OTT streaming platforms with 50K+ monthly users.

projects.title: vprofile-project — AWS Microservices Deployment
projects.description:
Set up a multi-tier architecture on AWS: EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer with Auto Scaling, so the app 
keeps running if a node drops. 
Ran Tomcat, RabbitMQ, Memcache, and MySQL in separate Security Groups and pointed DNS through Route 53 after 
transferring the domain from GoDaddy. Most of the time went into tracking down why the pieces weren't talking to each 
other.
